warnings: metric extent unavailable: the region's rays hit no modelled surface (no wall, floor or ceiling there)

footprint.note: Outer face of the connected wall graph: an envelope of the recovered walls, NOT a verified property footprint.

assumptions: Depth values are millimetres (0.001 m per unit).
Camera intrinsics refer to the RGB image and are scaled proportionally to the depth image.
Walls are vertical and floors horizontal in the capture's native frame (+Y is vertical).
Room polygons close only where wall evidence connects; nothing is extended beyond 0.5 m to close a corner.
Openings are structural gaps verified in 3D; door leaves, hardware and glazing are not detected.
provenance.coordinate_frame: capture-native world frame, top-down X-Z, metres; not reoriented or georeferenced

method.crack: black-hat dark-ridge extraction + elongation/thinness filters, straight lines rejected
method.detector: deterministic OpenCV image processing (no learned model)
method.mapping: pixel rays cast onto wall/floor/ceiling planes of the property; nearest valid surface; metric extent only if >= 80% of the outline agrees on one non-grazing surface
method.stain: chroma deviation from a median-filtered Lab background; pure shadows rejected

provenance.depth_scale_basis: assumed 0.001 m per raw depth unit, supported by multi-frame consistency and indoor scale, not proven by the data

damage_method.description: crack (dark thin ridges) and stain (chroma deviation) detectors; no learned model
damage_method.name: deterministic-opencv

determinism.deterministic: LiDAR reconstruction, drift stage, planes, walls, rooms, openings, scale estimation, gravity, fusion, stitching, damage analysis, serialization and rendering are deterministic for identical inputs.
not_bit_reproducible: PyCOLMAP structure-from-motion (video and photo tiers) is multi-threaded: registered image sets and poses can differ slightly between runs, and so can everything built on them.
Video seeking can land a few frames apart across decoder versions.

scope_line_items.basis: no reliable metric extent: quantity not estimated

Damage analysis is deterministic image processing (cracks, stains) on RGB evidence: detections are candidates, not verified defects, and no ground truth was available to measure precision or recall.
